summary: slo, incremental, otlp and telemetry no longer name store, api, client or driver_hook code: DatabaseSize moves into slo, the change feed and the OTLP observation log become small traits the store implements, the local-observation id scheme moves to the kernel model, HookEnv moves to telemetry, and the hook telemetry submit and the SLO windows are passed in by the caller

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay behaviour changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Same code paths, same wire contract, CLI output and exit codes; telemetry::hook gains a submit parameter and otlp::run_slo a windows parameter, both used only by the st3 binary.

downtime.detail: Nothing to restart beyond a normal upgrade.
